payload.text: **LESSONS candidates from vc's WP-02 re-verification (2026-09-17 afternoon), vc's call at a fold.** (hh) This Bash tool runs zsh: an unmatched glob in `rm -rf dir/*` aborted an && chain, the probe then sourced nothing and still exited 0, and only the normalised before/after diff showed it -- a probe must exit non-zero when its subject fails to load, and zsh-isms go through bash -c. (ii) An equivalent mutant is a finding about the code, not the tests: W07 showed a newline strip no caller can reach, because every caller passes a $(...) capture. (jj) One command held two rules for one input (0084): version's bare recipe follows a symlink while its sed recipes replace it, and version check agreed with both. (kk) dc's two: a second copy of a guarded library sourced into a shell that already has the first keeps the first, so a before/after probe compared new code with itself until it ran in a clean process; and a kill must be read at the arm meant for it (V10 dies only at the second-render arm).
